R: European Parliament and Council (Union legislature, acting through this Regulation) (regulator)

action: adopting a Union strategy on adaptation to climate change

T: sectors of the economy (undertakings choosing to prepare voluntary roadmaps) (target (voluntary participant))
action: engaging with and monitoring the development of voluntary sectoral roadmaps
object: indicative voluntary roadmaps towards the climate-neutrality objective
evidence_quote: The Commission shall engage with sectors of the economy within the Union that choose to prepare indicative voluntary roadmaps towards achieving the climate-neutrality objective set out in Article 2(1). The Commission shall monitor the development of such roadmaps.
coder_note: [reviewer_attention: conceptual_boundary] Genuinely ambiguous whether 'sectors of the economy' choosing a wholly voluntary process constitutes a regulated target in the RIT sense, or whether this is facilitative soft-law engagement outside the scope of a regulatory relationship. No third actor is involved

action: engaging with society for exchange of best practice
object: public participation and awareness on climate action
evidence_quote: The Commission shall engage with all parts of society to enable and empower them to take action towards a just and socially fair transition to a climate-neutral and climate-resilient society.
coder_note: [reviewer_attention: routine] No actor-specific regulatory relationship: 'all parts of society', social partners, academia, the business community, citizens and civil society are named as participants in an open engagement process, not as a regulated target or an intermediary performing a defined function. The European Climate Pact (Article 9(2)) is an instrument/initiative, not an actor.

action: self-assessing consistency of its own draft measures and legislative proposals
object: the Commission's own draft measures and legislative proposals
evidence_quote: The Commission shall assess the consistency of any draft measure or legislative proposal, including budgetary proposals, with the climate-neutrality objective set out in Article 2(1) and the Union 2030 and 2040 climate targets before adoption, and include that assessment in any impact assessment accompanying these measures or proposals, and make the result of that assessment publicly available at the time of adoption.
coder_note: [reviewer_attention: routine] The Commission assesses its own forthcoming proposals for internal consistency with the climate-neutrality objective

R: European Commission (regulator (sets and oversees accreditation conditions by delegated act))
mediating_function: accrediting persons as qualified verifiers, and exercising control, oversight and withdrawal of that accreditation
action: specifying and overseeing the conditions for granting, controlling and withdrawing accreditation of verifiers
object: verifiers' qualification to perform embedded-emissions verification
evidence_quote: A national accreditation body may, on request, accredit a person to be a verifier for the purpose of this Regulation where it considers, on the basis of the documentation submitted to it, that such person has the capacity to apply the verification principles referred to in Annex VI when performing the tasks of verification of the embedded emissions pursuant to Articles 8 and 10.

T: operators of installations in third countries (target)
action: registering operators and installations and requiring them to determine and verify embedded emissions
object: embedded emissions of goods produced at third-country installations
evidence_quote: The Commission shall, upon request by an operator of an installation located in a third country, register the information on that operator and on its installation in the CBAM registry referred to in Article 14.
coder_note: [reviewer_attention: routine] Operators are a distinct regulated actor from declarants

T: third countries or territories seeking electricity-market exemption (target)
action: assessing third countries' roadmaps and reports and granting or withdrawing electricity-market exemption from the CBAM
object: third countries' progress on electricity-market and climate-policy alignment conditions
evidence_quote: If a third country or territory has an electricity market which is integrated with the Union internal market for electricity through market coupling, and there is no technical solution for the application of the CBAM to the importation of electricity into the customs territory of the Union from that third country or territory, such importation of electricity from that country or territory shall be exempt from the application of the CBAM, provided that the Commission has assessed that all of the following conditions have been fulfilled in accordance with paragraph 8:
coder_note: [reviewer_attention: conceptual_boundary] A third country/territory is treated here as a T-like jurisdictional actor based on self-reporting (roadmap, biennial reports) directly to the Commission

I: Member States, affected/benefited parties, and interested parties such as environmental organisations and NGOs (candidate intermediary (notification channel))
T: producers, exporters, importers or traders engaged in practices of circumvention (target)
mediating_function: submitting formally-structured notifications that trigger a mandatory Commission investigation
action: monitoring and investigating practices of circumvention
object: practices of circumvention of the CBAM obligations
evidence_quote: A Member State or any party that has been affected by, or has benefited from, any of the situations referred to in paragraph 2 may notify the Commission if it is confronted with practices of circumvention. Interested parties other than directly affected or benefited parties, such as environmental organisations and non-governmental organisations, which find concrete evidence of practices of circumvention may also notify the Commission.

T: Member States and third countries or parts thereof (target)

I: natural or legal persons submitting substantiated concerns (intermediary (information transmission))
certification or other third-party verified schemes (candidate intermediary (supplementary risk-assessment input))
mediating_function: supplying complementary compliance evidence that operators may optionally use in their own risk assessment
object: compliance evidence considered within an operator's own risk assessment
evidence_quote: complementary information on compliance with this Regulation, which may include information supplied by certification or other third-party verified schemes

I: FLEGT licensing authorities/scheme (operating under Regulation (EC) No 2173/2005 Voluntary Partnership Agreements) (intermediary (certification))
T: operators and traders of FLEGT-licensed wood products (target)
mediating_function: issuing FLEGT licenses that are automatically and mandatorily deemed to satisfy the Article 3, point (b), legality requirement
action: determining whether a relevant product satisfies the legality requirement of Article 3, point (b)
object: legality of wood products under the relevant legislation of the country of production
evidence_quote: Wood products which fall within the scope of Regulation (EC) No 2173/2005 that are covered by a valid FLEGT license from an operational licensing scheme shall be deemed to comply with Article 3, point (b), of this Regulation.
